name: bygone-days-p1-controlled-ally-after-bygone-days-slot-shifts-on-sacrifice
notes: Bygone Days (wXNDSNQ2x2): the controller's ally (Fluffy Shopkeep, played for real after Bygone Days) sits on the field AFTER Bygone Days (field-2). Pre-fix, cascade 3 sacrificed Bygone Days immediately, before the option list was answered; its removed slot was spliced out first, so the offered 'myField-2' pointed past the end of the field and the chosen ally was silently not returned (memory 0). The sacrifice now follows the choices (printed order).

rulesClauses: 3: Each player chooses an ally they control and returns it to its owner's memory. Sacrifice Bygone Days.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. ResolveBygoneDaysCascade (cascade 3) had three defects. (1) PERSPECTIVE: the opponent's ally list was ZoneSearch("theirField", forPlayer:$player), a list in the TURN PLAYER's coordinate space, queued on the OPPONENT's own MZCHOOSE: the opponent was offered the turn player's field slots, their own allies were refused ('Invalid selection') and no ally of theirs could ever be returned. Fix: build each list in the answering player's own perspective (forPlayer:$opponent, 'myField'). (2) OWNERSHIP: BygoneDaysReturn called MZMove($obj->Owner, <chooser-relative mzID>, 'myMemory'); with Owner != chooser the source id was flipped onto the wrong slot and the destination to the wrong memory. Fix: MZMove from the chooser's perspective to myMemory/theirMemory by ownership. (3) SLOT ORDER: Bygone Days was sacrificed immediately, before the option lists were answered; its removed slot was spliced out first, so an ally listed AFTER Bygone Days on the field was one slot off and silently not returned. Fix: sacrifice after the choices (printed order) via BygoneDaysSacrifice, resolved by UniqueID after splicing removed cards.
